searchText: Hey, if this is the wrong place to ask please direct me to the right one haha <https://blog.ethereum.org/2014/11/25/proof-stake-learned-love-weak-subjectivity/> I’ve been reading this post, and in the section covering ESG mentions a tradeoff between subjectivity and resistance to forks that don’t last as long as the withdrawal period Does this interact with liveness? If you have a fork choice rule and a deposit period that guarantees resistance to attacks intended to rewrite the chain history (at the cost of complete subjectivity), does this imply you’ve chosen consistency over liveness and an attacker can still stop your chain?
